counting.note: The observation ingress is exactly one additional Gateway HTTP route, counted separately. It joins no MCP tool set, replaces no UI alias, and opens no native write surface. The count is never 'still 31+5'.

additional_gateway_http.dispatch: strictly before the native write catch-all; the write catch-all keeps every other /narralens/native/ path

authentication.cookie: the existing native HttpOnly SameSite=Strict cookie, issued by the controlled session exchange
authentication.csrf: the existing native CSRF proof header of the same session
authentication.session: a real, live ControlledStudioAccess session; a retired or superseded session answers 409
refused: the independent workbench UI cookie and its proof
another origin, a missing Host header or a duplicated header
a request without a cookie or without the CSRF proof
a session that was closed, superseded or whose generation moved

body.shape: exactly the four fields format, sequence, event_kind and event
body.sequence: 1..MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, strictly monotonic inside one real session; the latest sequence is recorded before the asynchronous verification, so a late callback can never re-green a session
body.identity: the envelope carries no logical project, actor, session, grant, Host revision, snapshot, source digest, approval or proof; every one of those comes from the session binding
body.checked_in_one_place: the Gateway and the observation service share one parser, so a body that is not the closed envelope is refused before the producer is reached and the two cannot drift apart

event_kinds.document: the original p2 NarralensDocumentState (protocol_version 1, native project and view, document epoch, committed or invalidated)
event_kinds.hydration: the original 013 hydration event (five fields, exactly the four parts settings, subtitle_style, captions and markers). The revalidation origin of the settings, the captions and the markers is project and their state is hydrated, including a legitimate empty parsed result; the subtitle style may be absent_default with origin explicit_default when the project has no style and the native uses the pinned default. A browser preference is never a proof, not even when its value happens to equal the default.
event_kinds.selection: the original StudioSelection, mapped onto the committed clip and time mapping

native_canonicalisation.seconds: native seconds are a fractional domain of their own; they are rounded half away from zero at the native millisecond and never enter the integer canonical domain of the contract
native_canonicalisation.effective_values: the exact 013 preimage narralens.native-hydration-effective@1 over {part,value}, hashed with the pinned canonical implementation

errors.400: malformed envelope, closed-field violation, body too large or an event that does not match its original schema
errors.401: no native cookie, no CSRF proof or an unknown session
errors.403: wrong origin, a duplicated header or a Host header that does not name the Gateway
errors.409: a retired, superseded or stale session; a sequence that is not monotonic
errors.503: no live controlled session, no observation producer, or the independent expected side is unavailable

side_effects.ingress: the observation only advances the Host's own observation state; it never writes a revision, an approval, a source or an a run
side_effects.acknowledgement: the frozen NativeAck DTO is written through the existing cp_a0_native_ack table on the existing Host connection; no new table, no second queue and no relaxed fingerprint
side_effects.no_media: an observation never starts a media producer, never decodes, never writes a preference and never mutates the native source

managed_013.note: The stale active metadata that names patch 198c8b5e is not a valid pin and is not used. The historical metadata bytes are preserved unchanged.

native_015.scope: the pinned helper proves settings and markers only. The film, the source closure, the subtitle style and the captions are proved independently, by the Host's committed reader and the fixed original native parser and consumer rules.

provenance.rule: every tracked input lists its source commit, its original path, its byte hash and every change made to it in this ticket

expected_side.description: What the editor is compared against, computed from the Host's committed source and never from the editor's rows.
expected_side.settings_captions_markers: the pinned 015 helper, over the parsed value; the presence of the source file is not what the state says
expected_side.subtitle_style: the Host's committed reader and the fixed original native parser rules, hashed with the pinned canonical implementation
expected_side.parts_compared: the state, the origin and the effective digest of each of the four parts, and the film's hash, its byte length and its native revision
expected_side.unsupported: an unsupported part, an unsupported origin or a moved closure produces no acknowledgement at all
